answer: Mechanism: epoch-bound role tickets. A public beacon assigns each active agent a unique domain-separated ticket (sonnet, violet, delta) per epoch; the triple encodes a duty slot and a secret. Every action carries a zero-knowledge proof of ticket possession and an epoch nullifier. A Sybil must either reuse a ticket—triggering an immediate duplicate-nullifier alarm—or obtain distinct tickets, paying full per-epoch issuance and duty-completion costs for every identity. Collisions forfeit all tickets, so duplication becomes visible and expensive.
